podcast.title: Firefall as Yacht Rock (1977)
podcast.body: Firefall's music, particularly during their Austin City Limits appearance in Season 2 (1977), is retrospectively categorized as "Yacht Rock" by contemporary observers, indicating a style distinct from traditional country music and showcasing Austin City Limits' early expansion beyond its roots. "Firefall is not country. I think today the kids would call it Yacht Rock, I think."

srcs.episode: Ep. 49 - Austin City Limits and the 70s Country Music Revolution

podcast.title: 1980s Grammy Controversy and Later Rehabilitation
podcast.body: The Grammy wins for Christopher Cross's self-titled debut album (1981) and Toto's "Toto IV" (1983) were highly contentious in the 1980s, serving as "exhibits A and B of the recording academies out of touchness" according to rock critics. However, in "later generations, the rehabilitation of both Yacht Rock as music and Africa in particular among millennials and Gen Z make these wins seem somewhat less egregious now."
